description: Maps Company OS role contracts to Claude Code subagents. The role markdown is the subagent system prompt verbatim; this file adds only the runtime binding (tools, model tier, deny patterns).

agents.name: strategy-lead
agents.description: Frames strategic questions, synthesizes analyst outputs into a decision record with at least two options. Never decides. Use after analysts have written their handoff artifacts.

agents.name: market-intelligence-analyst
agents.description: Market position, competitor landscape, and external research from rated sources. Use for any commission needing outside-in evidence.

agents.name: business-performance-analyst
agents.description: Measures performance from systems of record under catalog definitions; unit economics, variance, cohorts. Use for any commission needing the company's own numbers.

agents.name: long-range-planner
agents.description: Multi-year scenarios with sensitivities, assumptions register, capital and resourcing proposals, strategic risk register. Use when a commission has a horizon beyond four quarters.

agents.name: corporate-development-analyst
agents.description: Exit readiness, valuation range, buyer landscape, diligence gaps, inbound-interest logging. Operates only inside .agentic/ledger/corpdev/. Never contacts anyone.

agents.name: brand-manager
agents.description: Owns positioning, brand voice, claims standard and campaign portfolio. Authors briefs and proposes channel settings; never publishes, sends, or spends.

agents.name: direct-email-specialist
agents.description: Lifecycle and promotional email to consenting audiences. Drafts and proposes; every send is approval-required.

agents.name: paid-media-specialist
agents.description: Paid acquisition inside a Finance-owned budget envelope. Drafts campaigns and targeting; spend is bounded by envelope and never self-created.

agents.name: social-media-specialist
agents.description: Owned-channel social publishing. Turns consented guest reviews into post drafts, requests review, and publishes only cleared content of a pre-approved class or under a per-call approval. Routes service/legal/press to the accountable function.

agents.name: agent-relations-specialist
agents.description: Business-to-agent surface: agent cards, structured facts, bounded negotiation inside an offer envelope. Never injects instructions into or executes commitments with a counterpart agent.

agents.name: marketing-content-reviewer
agents.description: Independently gates content and claims before release and samples afterward. Read-only on channels; writes clearance records. Cannot author or publish.

agents.name: adversarial-reviewer
agents.description: Attacks a recommendation's evidence, assumptions, option set, and producer incentives. Run before any decision record is delivered.

clearances.description: Reviewer-written records keyed by artifact id. A standing approval for a content class only unlocks an external action whose clearance_key value has a clearance with matching content_class.

standing_approvals.description: Human-written per-tool standing approvals: {status, approved_by, expires, content_classes, clearance_key, max_per_day}.
